title: His five children and their music
summary: Wilson gives a rundown of Theodore, Steven, Bill, James and Dune, their ages, schooling and musical talents, all with perfect pitch.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: that marriage, a little girl, Dune, who's now 13 years old, D-u-n-e, and a brother James, who's 14 now. And he's named after my father, and my older brother, were both James. And also Joanne's son by her previous marriage with Bill Gidney is with us now and his name's William, we call him Bill. And Bill is now my adopted son. So his name is not Bill Gidney, it's Bill Wilson now. And let's see, Bill's a senior at Ohio State right now, and graduating this year, 1980. And Steven is enrolled in the Berkeley College of Music here in Boston, and has another year to go to graduate. And James, the younger ones, James and Dune, are in -- James is in high school in Hillsdale, New Jersey, first year of high school, and Dune is in the 8th grade of grammar school in Hillsdale. And my oldest son Theodore, the marriage with Janice in 1945, Theodore is now 33 years old and he's working with me on the bass and I have a family rhythm section along with Steven on the drums. And Theodore lives in Brooklyn and has been on the faculty of the Kingsboro College out there in Brooklyn and the Pace College of New York City, teaching percussion instruments and music history. And playing bass now but for the last two years before that, as you well know, he played drums for years because the three of us were a trio many times in New York and Texas and various places, Philadelphia, Florida. So that's a rundown on the boys.
I don't know if I gave their ages, June is 13 now,

1980, Dune is 13, James is 14, Steven is 21, Steven will turn 22 next month, February 7th, Bill is 22, he turned 22 about November 6th, he's three months older than Steven. And Ted has turned 33, his birthday's May 30th. Dune's birthday is December 6th and James' is July 27th. And these five are all very precious to me. Everyone is a musician and the interesting thing about them all, they've all got perfect pitch and I don't. I have lousy pitch but all my children have perfect pitch.

Dune, my little girl, plays alto saxophone, violin, and plays these instruments in the school ensemble groups. And she's been studying piano since she could just about walk. And she sings beautifully and also she studies tap, acrobatic, and a very talented ballet dancer. And with the dancing they've gone far enough to perform away from the school in some special events quite often.

And her brother James is 14, he's got a drum set and a French horn, and he's been playing the piano since he could walk, and studying piano, and he's now playing trumpet in the highschool marching-concert band and piano in the jazz band and he studies tap dancing and acrobatic dancing. And also performs with his sister occasionally. And Steven, as I mentioned, is at Berkeley College of Music.
I've heard Bill play some piano, I think.
Remember Michael's Club, once you brought him down with his group?
